 Published Nov. 11, 2026 4:43 a.m. ET share facebook x reddit link Associated Press Colgate Raiders (0-2) at St. John's Red Storm (2-0)
 New York; Wednesday, 7 p.m. EST
 BOTTOM LINE: No. 13 St. John's hosts Colgate after Tounde Yessoufou scored 23 points in St. John's 104-65 victory over the Iona Gaels.
 St. John's went 30-7 overall with a 15-2 record at home during the 2025-26 season. The Red Storm averaged 80.9 points per game while allowing opponents to score 69.6 last season.
 Colgate finished 12-8 in Patriot League action and 6-10 on the road last season. The Raiders averaged 14.6 assists per game on 28.1 made field goals last season.
